name: Michael Adam Winters
headline: Senior Technical Product Leader | Team Builder | Org Transformer
summary: Product Leader with 15+ years of experience at Amazon, Apple, Google, and Chewy, focused on transforming organizations from intuition-based decision-making to data-driven product strategy. resume_context: Michael Adam Winters is a Senior Technical Product Leader with 15+ years at Amazon (6 years), Apple, Google, and Chewy. At Chewy (Associate Director), he built the first automated compliance analytics platform, led PCI DSS 4.0 readiness across 3 entities (50% audit cycle reduction), operationalized CCPA/DSAR at enterprise scale (2-3K requests bi-weekly, 4-day completion vs 45-day SLA), directed 'Chewy Heartbeat' analytics dashboard for executive visibility, designed AI/LLM enablement for 20+ product teams, and managed 13 global reports. At Amazon, he led a 21-person CV/ML team deploying defect detection across 300+ fulfillment centers (11% defect reduction), re-architected the largest operational metrics platform (30K daily users, 97% page load improvement), built custom dashboard generators eliminating 3,000 hrs/week overhead, drove $32M cost avoidance, managed 3 managers + 30 ICs, and created Project Kariba ($293M supply chain savings). At Apple, he designed day-one Apple Watch 1.0 support (96% CSAT) and deployed video/chatbot tools across 5 global centers for 2,000+ agents. At Google, he managed the Walmart partnership ($10M+/month, 10K+ daily product ads). He founded Winters Product Group providing fractional product leadership and built VetReady, an AI-powered health platform using React/Supabase/Stripe/Vercel/Claude API. Core strengths: data-driven product strategy, platform modernization, compliance/GRC (PCI DSS, CCPA, BigID, SailPoint), AI/ML integration, analytics instrumentation, cross-functional leadership at scale, and transforming organizations from reactive to outcome-driven.
